partner_result_applied.application: With no conditioning and singleton blocks, delta<=1/48 and ||C-diag(C)||<=1/40 give a continuous density with norm <51; this is branch A of the new trichotomy.

other_dependency.application: At gamma=||E||/2, ridge effective dimension >=3 and max ridge diagonal <=1/2 imply a continuous density bound <280 in the high-stable-rank branch.

new_claims: QFORM-DIFFUSE-LARGE-DEFECT-STABLE-RANK-v1: for selected-frame row leverage <=1/48, if tau=||C-diag(C)||>1/40 and stable rank >=30, a physical cut has actual ridge effective dimension >=3; hence either the ridge theorem closes with continuous density <280 or a physical cross row has norm >1/(80 sqrt(2)).

QFORM-RANK3-COAREA-LINF-ONLY-FALSE-v1: bounded Linfinity norm of an arbitrary 3D density alone cannot uniformly control the pushforward under y1^2+y2^2-y3^2; an exact light-cone slab gives peak >=pi R/2 with density cap one. This refutes only the intermediate Linfinity-only coarea claim, not full QFORM.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-DIFFUSE-LOW-STABLE-RANK-OR-LOCALIZED-CLOSURE-v1: close stable-rank<30 off-diagonal residuals by grouped-coordinate product structure, or upgrade the fixed-scale localized cross row to a density bound with an independent selected-spectrum/pivot resource.
